title: Presets fetched once then subscribed; second window still offers yesterday's menu until save fires event
context: Tauri events have no replay buffer. Window that only subscribed would sit with empty menu until first save.
decision: Subscribe first (so events land), then fetch (so stale answers are discarded if events beat them home). Both paths needed; neither is redundant.
consequences: Second window gets the presets. Empty initial menu is never seen. Drift between windows is impossible.
